instructions_to_main_agent: Retheming: Update /app/frontend/src/index.css to import @fontsource-variable/outfit and @fontsource-variable/plus-jakarta-sans, set --font-sans to Plus Jakarta Sans and --font-heading to Outfit, and align :root and .dark tokens with #0B0B0B (background), #151515 (card), #FFD21C (primary/gold), #FFFFFF (foreground).
Header Component: Fixed header with frosted glass (bg-[#0B0B0B]/85 backdrop-blur-xl), Golden Sportswear logo with gold accent, navigation links, user login button, and cart icon with count badge.

Hero Section: Full dark look with background image, bold Portuguese tagline 'Vista sua presença.', subtitle 'Performance, atitude e acabamento premium para quem se move diferente.', CTA button 'Explorar destaques' in gold #FFD21C, and smooth motion entrance.
Categories: 6 categories (Camisas, Moletons, Tênis, Calças, Shorts, Acessórios) featuring gold border hover, smooth scale, and badge tags.

Products Grid: Fetch from GET /api/catalog/products with fallback fallback UI, display image from /api/files/{file_id} or luxury sports fallback, show name, brand, category, regular price, promotional price, badges (NOVO / OFERTA / MAIS VENDIDO), and quick 'Adicionar' button.
Cart /carrinho: localStorage persistent cart with quantity controls, subtotal, shipping calculation, total, and direct progression to checkout.
Checkout /checkout: Order review and PayPal payment box. If no keys are provided, show friendly locked state: 'PayPal indisponível no momento' & 'Nenhuma cobrança foi realizada'.
Authentication: Google Emergent auth + email/password login and register with JWT httpOnly cookies, password recovery modal, and role redirect.

Admin Dashboard /admin: Black and gold luxury sidebar layout. Dashboard KPIs, CRUD for products with image upload, categories manager, banners manager, clients, orders management with status flow, stock alerts, and financial reports.
RBAC: Enforce ADMIN (full access), ATENDENTE (view orders/clients/stock/reports), COMPRADOR (personal storefront, cart, orders, profile).
Ensure every interactive element has kebab-case data-testid attributes.
